title: El taller
goal: Ask for work and be told what you are actually worth
culture: Busco trabajo is not an embarrassing thing to say here and he has been asked it a hundred times. He is not deciding whether you are a mechanic; he is deciding whether you are worth a week, and overselling yourself is the fastest way back onto the street.

beats.en: I’m looking for work, don Emilio.
beats.good: No preamble. Busco trabajo is not embarrassing to say in this country and he has heard it a hundred times without thinking less of anybody.

beats.es: ¿Y usted sabe de esto o no sabe nada?
beats.en: I know a little. Not much.
beats.good: Sé un poco is the answer that survives the first hour. Claiming more than you have is the fastest way out of a workshop.

beats.objective: Give him the reason to try
beats.good: The pero does all the work. He is weighing a week of his time, not your qualifications.

beats.es: ¿Y por qué le voy a dar chance a usted?
beats.good: Pruébeme — try me. It costs him almost nothing to agree to and it is the one argument he has no answer for.
